outcomes: Apply a practical diagnosis, service, maintenance, and repair based on theory and operation of automotive brakes, suspension, and steering systems.

notes: The page prints one Program Outcomes list for the program as a whole; the certificate shares it, so it is recorded here.

The page covers an A.S. and a Certificate of Achievement (URL 'as-cert-achievement'), but only the certificate course list is printed; the A.S. section lists only general education information (PCC Local Gen Ed, Cal-GETC) with no unit totals. GE pattern left null for the certificate.

The description says 'An Occupational Skills Certificate is awarded upon successful completion of all required courses', which conflicts with the Certificate of Achievement heading; reviewer should check.

Careers recorded from the description's 'entry-level employment in brake system service, suspension inspections and repair, and tire and wheel repair including 4 wheel alignment'; these are employment areas rather than job titles.
Students are encouraged to take ASE exams (A4, A5); these are exams, not courses, so no recommended block was created.
